objectives.text: Take the libelous document from _temple_ in __temple_. A _guardian_ keeps it.
Deal with the _guardian_ who guards the document
Bring the document to _qgiver_ of ==qgiver_

outcomes.text: The libel against ==qgiver_ is in the coven's hands, and no one else's.
The libel went to the Imperial City, to be copied for the masses.

objectives.text: Lead _child_ home to _home_ in __home_. The coven's enemies will try to stop you.
Return to _qgiver_ in ___qgiver_ for your _gem_

outcomes.text: _child_ is home, and the kindness of ==qgiver_ is on every tongue.
_child_ never reached home with you, and ==qgiver_ are blamed for it.

objectives.text: Carry the coven's potion to _mage_ at the Mages Guild of ___mguild_. Beware those who hunt it by night.

outcomes.text: The potion reached the Mages Guild whole, and ==qgiver_ have the mages' regard.
You drank from the coven's potion, and _mage_ would not pay for a desecrated formula.
The potion never reached the Mages Guild, and the peace with the mages is broken.

objectives.text: Slay the vampire ancient =vamprival_ in ___mondung_
Return to _witch_ in ___witch_

outcomes.text: =vamprival_ is truly dead, and the witches of %reg sleep easier.
=vamprival_ still walks the night, feeding on the coven's sisters.

objectives.text: Find _witch_, imprisoned in ___mondung_, and give her the _clothes_ to disguise her
Bring _witch_ back to ==qgiver_

outcomes.text: _witch_ is home with her sisters, and ==qgiver_ owe you their respect.
The days ran out before _witch_ was brought home to ==qgiver_.

objectives.text: Meet _contact_, a =contact_, at __contact_ in ___contact_ for the stolen book
Bring _book_ to ==qgiver_ before the guards of ___contact_ catch you

outcomes.text: _book_ is on the coven's shelf, and the guards never found it.
_book_ came too late. ==qgiver_ had no more use for it.
_book_ never reached ==qgiver_.

objectives.text: Give the _jewelry_ to _man_ at _tavern_ in __tavern_, as a gift from an old lover
Return to ==qgiver_

outcomes.text: _man_ wore the coven's gift, and now looks as foul as he truly is.
You killed what _man_ became. It was too quick a death for ==qgiver_, who cursed you with the pox for it.
_man_ laughs still at what he owes ==qgiver_.

objectives.text: Find the _item1_ in ___dungeon1_
Find the _item2_ in ___dungeon2_
Find the _item3_ in ___dungeon3_
Bring all three to _qgiver_ in ___qgiver_ before the brew cools

outcomes.text: The weather-weaving brew is made, and ==qgiver_ paid in glittering stones.
The brew went cold without its three ingredients.

objectives.text: Get the _magicitem_ from _other_ of ==other_ in ___other_
Come back to _other_ with 1000 gold pieces for the _magicitem_
Bring the _magicitem_ to _questgiver_ in ___questgiver_

outcomes.text: The _magicitem_ is rent and boiled in the coven's tub, and its spell is woven.
The _magicitem_ never reached ==questgiver_.

objectives.text: Slay a seducer, daedroth, fire or frost daedra in ___mondung_ and take its heart
Bring the heart to _questgiver_ in ___questgiver_ while it still beats

branches.text: The heart still beats, and the witches ask what you will have for it.

choices.text: Nothing, as a gift for your dear aunts

outcomes.text: The heart went into the coven's pot still beating, and the _reward_ is yours.
The heart went into the coven's pot still beating. It was a gift to your dear aunts, who will not forget it.
No daedra's heart reached the coven's pot in time.
